firstLines: Licensed pharmacist with five years in community and ambulatory care, focused on diabetes and anticoagulation.
Ambulatory Care Pharmacy Specialist Jan 2024 – Present
• Monitor about 180 patients on warfarin and DOACs and recommend dose changes to their four primary care
• Started a diabetes visit for patients with an A1c over 9; average A1c in the group fell from 10.2 to 8.1 in six
• Review high-risk medication lists for patients leaving the hospital and call each one within 72 hours
• Ran a store filling about 1,600 prescriptions a week with three pharmacists and eight technicians
• Gave about 4,000 vaccines a season and set up walk-in clinic hours that doubled flu shot volume
• Passed every state board inspection and cut controlled substance count discrepancies to zero for two years
• Took medication histories in the emergency department and flagged dosing problems for the clinical
Marlbrook University School of Pharmacy Greenville, NC
• Rotations: internal medicine, ambulatory care, oncology, community pharmacy
License: Pharmacist, North Carolina; immunization certified
